tools.name: due_services
tools.description: Compute which scheduled maintenance services (oil, tires, brakes, filters, fluids, plugs, transmission, battery) are due, soon or ok from the current odometer and optional per-service history. Returns km and month distances to each due point.

tools.name: service_cost_estimate
tools.description: Estimate typical US parts-and-labor price ranges for a chosen list of maintenance services at a chosen shop tier (economy, mid or luxury). Returns per-service ranges and a total range.

tools.name: service_timeline
tools.description: Project the next 12 months of driving from a monthly km rate and list which maintenance services fall due in each month, with the projected odometer at that month.

tools.name: seasonal_checklist
tools.description: Seasonal car checklist for spring, summer, fall or winter, adjusted for a hot, cold or mixed climate. Groups practical preventive checks by area (battery, tires, fluids, visibility, safety kit).
